Let S_n=1+3+5+\u2026+(2n-1). For n=1, S_1=1=1^2. Assume S_k=k^2 for some k. Then
S_{k+1}=S_k+(2(k+1)-1)=k^2+2k+1=(k+1)^2.
Thus the identity holds for k+1 whenever it holds for k; together with the base case, it holds for every positive integer n.
